header: The planner: what a typed line could be, from its words alone (pure, offline, a few microseconds, no model, no database). I use it for two things only:
1. the hint under the box while the person types ("Looks like PAX: choose PAX to search it directly"), and
2. the shadow log of the server (x-omni-plan), which records what the planner would have chosen beside what actually answered, so a later step can compare them.

It never routes a line by itself: with the selection on "Everything" the existing paths decide exactly as before; with a selection chosen the reader decided. It follows the order of docs/QUERY_UMBRELLA_PLAN.md: an explicit domain word, then an exact identifier, then the shape of a name, with the margin that asks instead of guessing.

symbols.name: MARGIN
doc: Two claims in different domains that are closer than this are not guessed between.

symbols.name: PRECEDENCE
doc: Domains whose NAME is in the line, in the order that settles a clash between two of them (I decided this order, nothing is guessed): "pax number of hospital opd" is a PAX question, "holiday list for the hospital" a holiday one. The earlier wins; they are never reported as ambiguous with each other.

symbols.name: suggestDomain
symbols.sig: export function suggestDomain(line: string): DomainId | null
doc: Returns the domain to suggest under the box, or null when the line is only text or two readings are close; in that case I suggest nothing.
